system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 13. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (20 seconds, code score 0.89) ---
[b00] SFX: Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
[b01] ALEXANDER (desperate, choked): "Please... enough!"
[b02] ACTION: Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
[b03] JULIANA (screaming in pain): "Ah!"
[b04] ACTION: Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
[b05] ALEXANDER (furious, booming): "Stop!"
[b06] ACTION: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
[b07] JULIANA (agonized scream): "Ahhh!"
[b08] ALEXANDER (roaring in torment): "Juliana!"

--- WINDOW 1 (33 seconds, code score 0.87) ---
[b00] ACTION: Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.
[b01] ALEXANDER (pleading, agonized): "Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this."
[b02] JULIANA (quiet, unwavering): "I must."
[b03] ALEXANDER (terrified for her): "They will tear your hands apart."
[b04] JULIANA (soft, reassuring): "I will be fine."
[b05] ALEXANDER (desperate, fierce): "I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me."
[b06] JULIANA (emotional, devoted): "You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now."
[b07] ACTION: Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
[b08] CLARISSA (mocking, vindictive): "Careful, sister."

--- WINDOW 2 (22 seconds, code score 0.82) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
[b01] ALEXANDER (strangled, weeping): "Please..."
[b02] ACTION: Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.
[b03] JULIANA (gasping in pain): "No..."
[b04] CLARISSA (gleeful, derisive): "Look at her hands."
[b05] CLARISSA (mocking, spiteful): "The lady has finally found something worthy of her."
[b06] ACTION: Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
[b07] GERALD (taunting, cruel): "Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden."
[b08] SFX: Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
[b09] ALEXANDER (desperate, choked): "Please... enough!"

--- WINDOW 3 (31 seconds, code score 0.80) ---
[b00] ACTION: Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
[b01] ALEXANDER (furious, booming): "Stop!"
[b02] ACTION: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
[b03] JULIANA (agonized scream): "Ahhh!"
[b04] ALEXANDER (roaring in torment): "Juliana!"
[b05] ACTION: Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
[b06] ALEXANDER (desperate shout): "Juliana!"
[b07] JULIANA (panting, praying): "Please, ring... you have to be here."
[b08] ACTION: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
[b09] ACTION: Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.

Pick the single best promo.
